'''Matcha Flavoured 1.11''', the "Recipe Hotfix", is a hotfix for [[Matcha Flavoured 1.10|1.10]], published on August 11, 2026, a few hours after it.

== Fixes ==
* 1.10 had accidentally shipped without the pack's recipes. They were restored.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.11|quote=I accidentally deleted all the recipes...sorry}}</ref>
